tagline: Make a game, rewind a run, and turn playtest moments into the next version

examples.prompt: Make a low-poly snowboarding game with pine trees, six golden gates, carving and jumping. Support Rewind and Try from here for the complete game state so I can retry a jump and pin precise playtest feedback.
examples.caption: Alpine Drift · a real playable run, rewind, retry and saved feedback

examples.prompt: Make a synthwave hoverbike racer: ride down a neon grid canyon toward a striped setting sun, weave between glowing pylons, hop barriers and collect energy cores, with a boost and three shields.
examples.caption: Neon Drift · 3D synthwave hoverbike racer · playable in Game Studio

examples.prompt: Make a low-poly sailing game: steer a little sloop around a sunny archipelago of palm islands with a lighthouse, find twelve floating treasure chests marked by beams of light before the sun sets, and watch out for reefs.
examples.caption: Treasure Isles · 3D low-poly sailing treasure hunt · playable in Game Studio

examples.prompt: Make a small rooftop delivery game with three jumps, a visible destination and forgiving controls. Make Rewind and Try from here work for the complete game state, so I can replay a difficult moment and leave useful playtest notes.
examples.caption: A screenshot, complete game state, feedback and that version's compiled game.
